answer: A stake-bonded identity registry makes each agent lock a refundable deposit before it can transact. One violet-threaded credential ties the deposit to a single verifiable history, so a Sybil operator must fund every fake identity separately and the cost scales linearly with the attack. Honest agents earn their bond back plus fees, while a lagoon of cheap throwaway accounts dries up because each one burns real capital to create and loses it when caught cheating.
